title: Fast of Nineveh
description: A three-day fast of repentance before Great Lent.

title: Great Lent
description: The Great Fast of repentance, prayer, and preparation for the resurrection.

title: Mount of Olives Sunday
description: A Lenten Sunday focused on vigilance, judgment, and readiness.

title: Palm Sunday
description: Commemorates Christ’s triumphant entry into Jerusalem.

title: Good Friday
description: Commemorates the crucifixion and saving passion of Christ.

title: Resurrection / Easter
description: Celebrates the resurrection of Christ and His victory over death.

title: Meeting of Priests
description: A Paschal-cycle observance after the resurrection period.

title: Thomas Sunday / New Sunday
description: The first Sunday after Fasika, commemorating Christ’s appearance to Saint Thomas.

title: Pentecost
description: Celebrates the descent of the Holy Spirit upon the Apostles.

title: Siklet (Good Friday)
calculation_basis: bahire-hasab: days after Fast of Nineveh (Monday)
description: Compute from Nineveh Monday + 67 days (standard Bahire Hasab table).

title: Erget (Ascension)
calculation_basis: bahire-hasab: days after Fast of Nineveh (Monday)
description: Compute from Nineveh Monday + 108 days (standard Bahire Hasab table).
